corrected_diagnosis.cause: The expired reduce-only target adjustment rounded to zero lots. It was not a failed horizon or risk close. The earlier report incorrectly attributed suspension to the predeclared loss/drawdown limit.
corrected_diagnosis.correct_engine_behavior: Discard a non-mandatory reduce-only adjustment that rounds to zero without halting. Expired horizon_exit and risk_exit orders remain priority exits and preserve the unresolved-position diagnostic when they cannot close.

cadence_gap.attribution: The user paper timer was stopped during maintenance and started again 16 seconds later. The service itself ran for about 0.1 seconds. This was a maintenance pause, not evidence of a 20.7-second scheduler delay or a reason to lengthen execution deadlines.

quote_freshness_observation.finding: BBO data is arriving, but none of these three sampled latest quotes met the frozen one-second age bound. A prior spot sample was within the bound; the short observation does not establish consistently eligible quotes at execution time.

residual_position.handling: Keep the residual position and original fill in the v2 ledger. Do not erase it, mark it flat, or invent a retroactive close. A future-only simulated close would require an explicit exit-only procedure, a continuous session and a BBO no older than one second when execution is processed, plus valid lot/price rules and venue minimum size.

prospective_proof.reason: The old session is suspended and is no longer processed by the normal active-session loop; the residual is unresolved, and the short quote observation did not establish the frozen freshness bound. No eligible live opportunity was demonstrated.
prospective_proof.bounded_synthetic_path: Targeted tests demonstrate one virtual entry, one virtual exit, a flat end state and a cost-inclusive metrics report. This verifies reducer wiring only; it is not a live paper result or profitability evidence.
prospective_proof.restart_condition: First resolve the old residual through an explicitly authorized future-only exit procedure, or record a separately governed administrative-incomplete disposition that preserves the old ledger. Any later paper session must have a distinct session/version identity and must not claim continuity or transferred flatness. For this v2 execution contract, require a same-session BBO age <= 1000 ms at processing, valid venue precision, and an order meeting the 10 USDC minimum.
